'''Merikon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] operated a training facility on the planet. [[Ivhin Jayme]], a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], received intensive training by the Merikon instructors while at the facility.
